items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, she taught at Newcomb, didn't she? ... [INTERVIEWEE] They still, they don't teach no more now. But they, I don't know what they are, there's something in that Newcomb and Tulane and Loyola...

ctx.x: Well, she taught at Newcomb, didn't she? Hmm? She taught at Newcomb College, didn't she?

They still, they don't teach no more now. But they, I don't know what they are, there's something in that Newcomb and Tulane and Loyola, Loyola as they call it. Yes. Oh, those are smart people. Hmm. Hmm.
Oh, you're not taking a picture of me, I hope. No, no. No, no.
